description: Unit tests for the GitCL class in the webkitpy project, testing methods related to running commands, fetching issue numbers, and analyzing build results.

classes.name: GitCLTest
classes.description: Test suite for the GitCL class, covering command execution, issue number retrieval, and build result analysis.

methods.name: test_run
methods.description: Tests the run method of GitCL for executing commands and capturing output.

methods.name: test_run_with_auth
methods.description: Tests the run method with authentication token parameter.

methods.name: test_some_commands_not_run_with_auth
methods.description: Ensures certain commands are run without auth parameters.

methods.name: test_get_issue_number
methods.description: Tests extraction of issue number from command output.

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_empty
methods.description: Checks that empty job list returns True for all_jobs_finished.

methods.name: test_wait_for_try_jobs_time_out
methods.description: Simulates timeout during wait_for_try_jobs and verifies output.

methods.name: test_wait_for_try_jobs_done
methods.description: Verifies behavior when try jobs complete successfully.

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_with_started_jobs
methods.description: Checks that presence of started jobs returns False.

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_only_completed_jobs
methods.description: Verifies that only completed jobs return True.

methods.name: test_has_failing_try_results_empty
methods.description: Checks that empty results list returns False.

methods.name: test_has_failing_try_results_only_success_and_started
methods.description: Verifies no failure results are detected when only success or started.

methods.name: test_latest_try_builds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of latest build info for specified builders.
